_note: my-konsole runtime UI config — theme, font, terminal, keybindings. Read at runtime (get_config), synced to ~/.local/share/my-konsole/config.json by build.sh; edits apply on restart with no rebuild.

font.family: JetBrainsMono Nerd Font, JetBrains Mono, monospace

engine._note: WebView/browser ONLY: which my-konsole-engine ws server the terminal connects to. transport.js reads window.MYK_ENGINE_URL (set by the index.html <head> bootstrap from localStorage 'myk-engine-url') or falls back to the first backend's url. Desktop (Tauri) IGNORES this — it uses in-process PTYs. Switch at runtime via the ⚙ engine pill in the top nav (persists in localStorage, reloads to reconnect). Keep the default backend's url == transport.js fallback (ws://127.0.0.1:7333) so a fresh load needs no reload. Ports are per-env: run the my-konsole-engine on a distinct port in each env (nix-on-droid vs the separate Termux app) — EDIT these urls to match your real engine ports.

_keybindings_note: Konsole defaults — fully data-driven; edit + restart (no rebuild). Match = ctrl/shift/alt booleans + key (KeyboardEvent.code). Multiple rows may map to one action. actions: new-tab, close-tab, next-tab, prev-tab, move-tab-left, move-tab-right, copy, paste, find, split-left-right, split-top-bottom, close-view, focus-next-view, focus-prev-view, clear-scrollback.
